title: Payment service replacement collides with provider extension
description: Two agents have individually reasonable plans that imply incompatible ownership of PaymentService.

ground_truth.rationale: Replacing the service removes or narrows the extension point that the PayPal task expects to modify.

success_criteria: A conflict is returned while both worktrees still have clean diffs.
The evidence identifies PaymentService or the payments.provider contract.
The suggested coordination includes a PaymentProvider-style abstraction.
Both semantic claims remain advisory and are recorded.
